exposure: CFTR modulator use (Highly Effective Modulator Therapy - HEMT, and other modulators)
cohort: The study included 307 pregnancies in female individuals with Cystic Fibrosis (mean age at conception 28.5 years) from 11 US adult CF centers between 2010 and 2021.
finding: Female individuals with CF who used highly effective modulator therapy (HEMT) experienced superior pregnancy and after-pregnancy pulmonary outcomes, including preservation of ppFEV1, compared to those unexposed to HEMT.
